_comment: Requester's reference manifest for the IDM launch. NOT the launch manifest: IMD's manifest step writes launch.json after the adaptation is accepted (see ADAPTATION.md). Kept for the record of the intended values.
notes: Robinhood Chain 4663, launch.open kind univ4_hook, pairWith eth (native ETH, currency 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000, always currency0; IDM is currency1). Build from the repository root (foundry.toml src = src). The paired currency is not a constructor argument: the manifest has no placeholder for it and refuses a hand-written zero address, so the hook binds the quote from the PoolKey the factory opens. Resolve $poolManager, predicted $token and $factory for the selected LaunchFactory; mine hook flags 0x3040 with the final constructor arguments and the factory CREATE2 deployer. The constructor makes no external calls. Factory-only initialization binds exactly one sorted IDM/ETH pool at fee 12500 and tickSpacing 60. afterInitialize seeds SPEC section 3 state; afterSwap reads the actual BalanceDelta (|ETH delta| drives the rules) and the post-swap tick, mutates two packed words and emits Mutated/Movement/Drop/Accumulated/TrackComplete. No owner, admin, fees, return deltas, payable/receive or fund handling in the hook. hat/glitch/snare thresholds are ETH wei from src/QuoteCalibration.sol (0.00125/0.0125/0.0625 ETH, kept in the ABI; v2 classifies relative to the size EMA). The whale threshold is not an argument: K*sqrt(FDV) from the post-swap tick, clamped to 0.005..50 ETH (whaleThreshold()). initialPrice is the 1:1 placeholder the launch facts give; the deployer opens the pool at the policy's opening market cap (10 ETH for the whole supply) once the token address, and so the currency order, is known. The fixed-supply token mints 1e27 units once to its deployer; the factory performs all allocations and single-sided seeding (the requester's 90% to the pool, the swarm's 10% to the MerkleDistributor). No transaction has been broadcast from this repository; IMD's deployer launches after acceptance. Preserve SPEC.md section 3, vectors and the event/state ABI bit-for-bit. Gas: GAS.md.
